thread:
maria: FYI ran into a painful edge today — tenant `acme-corp` requested a full audit export (7M events) and the job failed with 429s midway.
kevin: ugh. do you have the request/response? 429 body? retry headers?
maria: pasted minimal repro below

```
POST /v1/audit/exports
{
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "start": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "end": "2025-06-30T23:59:59Z",
  "format": "ndjson",
  "include_proof": true
}
=> 429 {
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "retry_after": 60
}
```

maria: system returned a 202 then we got worker-side 429 when streaming to the storage backend. export died and user got a broken link.

sre-bot: @ops paging: export job id 0x9a3f queued -> failed_with_quota_backpressure

olivia: two quick ideas: 1) preflight (estimate size + required quota) so console can warn before starting; 2) chunked uploads -> presigned parts so workers can retry per-chunk and back off without killing whole job.

kevin: +1 to preflight. also we should avoid forcing include_proof on default exports — proof (signatures/rollout evidence) multiplies payload size. make proof opt-in and streamable per-event. we need a schema for the provenance stamp we add to each event: `actor_id`, `actor_hint`, `rollout_id`, `route_hash`, `proof_signature` (optional).

product-ana: for the Console UX: show "estimated export size" and a toggle: "include change provenance (adds ~X%)" with a tooltip explaining retention and PII impact. if preflight says > quota, show cancel/queue options.

maria: agreed. specific operational ask: how should API behave when quota triggers mid-export? current behavior kills job. options: 1) fail hard (current), 2) pause and resume once quota frees, 3) partial export with a manifest that notes truncation.

kevin: preference = pause/resume for Dedicated customers (we can hold spot in queue). For hosted users maybe return partial + manifest + recommended retry-after. we should surface `export.status` values: queued, running, paused, completed, partial, failed.

olivia: implementation notes: - preflight endpoint POST /v1/audit/exports/preflight -> estimate tokens/events/size - export worker writes NDJSON chunks of N events (default 10k) to presigned parts, publishes manifest.json linking parts and provenance metadata - if worker hits quota, it marks job paused and schedules retry with exponential backoff; manager reclaims slot only after X.

maria: will that meet compliance needs? regulators want an unbroken chain of who changed what. partial exports + manifest need to be explicit that events after cut were not exported.

kevin: yes — manifest must include `exported_range`, `truncated_at` (if any), `paused_reason`, and a `proof_anchor` (hash of last exported event). also add `schema_version` (v2) so clients can parse new provenance fields opt-in.

product-ana: telemetry: product wants signals for export quality: `export.requested`, `export.preflight_estimated_size`, `export.queued`, `export.started`, `export.paused`, `export.completed`, `export.failed`, `export.partial`. sample large exports (>=1M events) at 1% for payload telemetry, but always emit lifecycle events (no payload).

sre-bot: ops policy: for Dedicated customers we allow pause+resume, for hosted we allow partial + retry-after header. add admin quota override endpoint for support to bump tenant quotas temporarily.

maria: nice — action list for eng:
- add POST /v1/audit/exports/preflight
- implement chunked NDJSON presigned parts + manifest (default chunk_size=10000)
- include opt-in `include_proof` with schema v2 fields
- export lifecycle states + resume capability for Dedicated
- console: preflight UI, progress + estimated size, truncated warnings
- telemetry event names + sampling doc

kevin: will prototype API shape this week. I'll put a short RFC with example manifest and ndjson sample.

olivia: I'll mock the console flow and show the preflight modal + CTA (queue vs cancel) by EOD Friday.

product-ana: I'll update compliance docs to explain "paused" and "partial" states and what evidence the manifest includes.

maria: thanks all. reassigning to kevin for RFC + PR. :thumbsup:
